page:
- SSG Helper: generates a static site from a Hono application by retrieving registered routes' contents and saving them as static files
- Manual usage: build a Hono app, then a Node.js build script calling `toSSG(app, fs)` (with `fs` from `fs/promises`) outputs files like `./static/index.html`, `./static/about.html`
- Vite Plugin `@hono/vite-ssg` automates the process
- `toSSG(app, fsModule, options?)` is the main generator function (`ToSSGInterface`); `fsModule` implements `FileSystemModule` with `writeFile` and `mkdir`; Deno and Bun have dedicated `toSSG` imports from `hono/deno` / `hono/bun`
- `ToSSGOptions`: `dir` (default `./static`), `concurrency` (default `2`), `extensionMap`, `plugins`; `ToSSGResult`: `success`, `files`, `error?`
- File naming rules: `/` -> `index.html`, `/path` -> `path.html`, `/path/` -> `path/index.html`; extension determined by response `Content-Type`, customizable via `extensionMap`
- SSG-aware middleware: `ssgParams` (like Next.js `generateStaticParams`), `isSSGContext` (detects SSG execution), `disableSSG` (excludes a route from generation), `onlySSG` (route becomes `c.notFound()` after generation)
- Plugins extend generation via hooks: `beforeRequestHook`, `afterResponseHook`, `afterGenerateHook`; built-in `defaultPlugin` (skips non-200 responses, applied by default unless custom plugins are given) and `redirectPlugin` (generates HTML meta-refresh redirect pages for 301/302/303/307/308 responses, must be placed before `defaultPlugin`)
- Questions answered: How do I generate a static site from a Hono app? How do I customize output file extensions or directory? How do I generate dynamic static routes with parameters? How do I exclude an API route from static generation? How do I generate a sitemap.xml during SSG? Why isn't defaultPlugin applied when I specify custom plugins?

sections.manifest:
- Manual approach: define a Hono app (e.g. routes `/` and `/about` using `c.setRenderer`/`c.render`), then create a Node.js build script `build.ts` importing the app and `toSSG` from `hono/ssg`, plus `fs from 'fs/promises'`, calling `toSSG(app, fs)`
- Running the script outputs files to `./static`, e.g. `about.html` and `index.html`
- Vite Plugin: `@hono/vite-ssg` handles the SSG process automatically; see https://github.com/honojs/vite-plugins/tree/main/packages/ssg
- Answers: How do I generate static HTML files from a Hono app manually with a build script? How do I use a Vite plugin for Hono SSG instead of a manual script?

- `toSSG` is the main function for generating static sites, taking an application and a filesystem module as arguments
- Input: `ToSSGInterface` signature `(app: Hono, fsModule: FileSystemModule, options?: ToSSGOptions): Promise<ToSSGResult>`; `app` is a `new Hono()` instance with registered routes; `fs` implements `FileSystemModule` with `writeFile(path, data): Promise<void>` and `mkdir(path, { recursive }): Promise<void | string>`, assuming `node:fs/promise`
- Adapters for Deno and Bun: `import { toSSG } from 'hono/deno'` or `'hono/bun'`, called as `toSSG(app)` (second arg is `ToSSGOptions`)
- Options (`ToSSGOptions`): `dir?: string` (output destination, default `./static`), `concurrency?: number` (concurrent file generation count, default `2`), `extensionMap?: Record<string, string>` (maps Content-Type to file extension), `plugins?: SSGPlugin[]` (extends the generation process)
- Output (`ToSSGResult`): `success: boolean`, `files: string[]`, `error?: Error`
- Answers: What is the function signature of toSSG? What interface must my filesystem module implement? How do I use toSSG on Deno or Bun? What are the default values for dir and concurrency? What does toSSG return on completion?

- Route and Filename rules for the default `./static` output directory: `/` -> `./static/index.html`; `/path` -> `./static/path.html`; `/path/` -> `./static/path/index.html`
- File Extension depends on the `Content-Type` returned by each route (e.g. `c.html` responses saved as `.html`)
- Customize extensions via the `extensionMap` option, e.g. `toSSG(app, fs, { extensionMap: { 'application/x-html': 'html', ...defaultExtensionMap } })` importing `defaultExtensionMap` from `hono/ssg`
- Paths ending with a slash are always saved as `index.ext` regardless of extension, e.g. `/html/` -> `./static/html/index.html`, `/text/` -> `./static/text/index.txt`
- Answers: How does toSSG decide the output filename for a route? How do I map a custom Content-Type to a file extension? Why does a trailing-slash route save as index.ext instead of a named file?

- Built-in middleware supporting SSG: `ssgParams`, `isSSGContext`, `disableSSG`, `onlySSG`
- `ssgParams`: like Next.js's `generateStaticParams`; example `app.get('/shops/:id', ssgParams(async () => { const shops = await getShops(); return shops.map((shop) => ({ id: shop.id })) }), handler)` to pre-generate dynamic routes
- `isSSGContext`: helper returning `true` if the current app is running within the SSG context triggered by `toSSG`; example checks `isSSGContext(c)` to return different text for SSG vs dynamic serving
- `disableSSG`: routes with this middleware are excluded from static file generation, e.g. `app.get('/api', disableSSG(), handler)`
- `onlySSG`: routes with this middleware are overridden by `c.notFound()` after `toSSG` execution completes, e.g. `app.get('/static-page', onlySSG(), handler)`
- Answers: How do I generate static pages for dynamic routes with parameters, like Next.js generateStaticParams? How do I detect if code is running during SSG generation? How do I exclude an API route from static generation? How do I make a route only exist during SSG and 404 at runtime?

- Plugins extend the static site generation process using hooks at different stages
- Default Plugin: `defaultPlugin` (from `hono/ssg`) skips non-200 status responses (redirects, errors, 404s) to prevent generating files for unsuccessful responses; automatically applied when no plugins are specified; equivalent to `toSSG(app, fs, { plugins: [defaultPlugin] })`; if custom plugins are specified, `defaultPlugin` is NOT automatically included — it must be explicitly added to keep the default behavior
- Redirect Plugin: `redirectPlugin` generates HTML redirect pages (with a meta-refresh tag and a canonical link) for routes returning HTTP redirects (301, 302, 303, 307, 308); e.g. `app.get('/old', (c) => c.redirect('/new'))` generates `/old.html` redirecting to `/new`; must be placed BEFORE `defaultPlugin` in the plugins array, since `defaultPlugin` skips non-200 responses and would otherwise block it
- Hook Types: `BeforeRequestHook = (req: Request) => Request | false` (return false to skip the route); `AfterResponseHook = (res: Response) => Response | false` (return false to skip file generation); `AfterGenerateHook = (result: ToSSGResult) => void | Promise<void>` (called after generation completes)
- Plugin Interface `SSGPlugin`: `beforeRequestHook?`, `afterResponseHook?`, `afterGenerateHook?` (each single or array)
- Example plugins: filter GET-only requests via `beforeRequestHook`; filter by status code (200 or 500) via `afterResponseHook`; log generated files via `afterGenerateHook`; an advanced example builds a `sitemap.xml` file in `afterGenerateHook` using `DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR` from `hono/ssg`, `node:fs/promises`, and `node:path`
- Answers: Why isn't my custom plugin's redirect page generated when combined with defaultPlugin? How do I generate a sitemap.xml automatically during SSG? How do I skip generating files for certain responses (e.g. non-GET requests or specific status codes)? What hooks are available for SSG plugins and when do they run?
